scores.question: Which agreements give a party audit rights?
scores.answer:
The following agreements grant audit or record-examination rights:

- **Site Development and Hosting Agreement** — HDI may inspect records relating to payment calculations. [AMERICASSHOPPINGMALLINC_12_10_1999-EX-10.2-SITE DEVELOPMENT AND HOSTING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **License Agreement** — ArTara and its CRO may examine original medical records and supporting Program Data records. [ArtaraTherapeuticsInc_20200110_8-K_EX-10.5_11943350_EX-10.5_License Agreement.pdf p. 4]
- **Development Agreement** — Bioamber may audit Cargill’s time sheets annually through an agreed independent third party. [BIOAMBERINC_04_10_2013-EX-10.34-DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (1).pdf p. 2]
- **Servicing Agreement** — the Owner may inspect the Servicer’s books and records relating to services. [CUROGROUPHOLDINGSCORP_05_04_2020-EX-10.3-SERVICING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **Transportation Services Agreement** — either party may access transaction records and request validation through an agreed auditor. [DYNAMEXINC_06_06_1996-EX-10.4-TRANSPORTATION SERVICES AGREEMENT.PDF p. 6]
- **Online Hosting Agreement** — Diplomat may examine and copy Tadeo’s books and records concerning the services. [DYNTEKINC_07_30_1999-EX-10-ONLINE HOSTING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 3]
- **Strategic Alliance Agreement** — USA MCO may audit iMedicor’s records during regular business hours. [ICORECONNECTINC_10_13_2010-EX-7.1-Strategic Alliance Agreement.PDF p. 2]
- **Strategic Alliance Agreement** — Dynamic Hearing may appoint an independent auditor to inspect, copy and audit IntriCon’s records. [INTRICONCORP_03_10_2009-EX-10.22-Strategic Alliance Agreement.PDF p. 12]
- **Franchise Agreement** — the Franchisor may audit the Franchisee concerning the Smaaash Centres and inspect related records. [SimplicityEsportsGamingCompany_20181130_8-K_EX-10.1_11444071_EX-10.1_Franchise Agreement.pdf p. 6]
- **Endorsement Agreement** — Consolidated Artists and Advantage may inspect and copy TPC’s records relating to royalty calculations. [TEARDROPGOLFCO_10_23_1996-EX-10.12-ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT.PDF p. 4]
- **Marketing Agreement** — Vertex may have a third-party accountant examine Bunker One’s records. [VertexEnergyInc_20200113_8-K_EX-10.1_11943624_EX-10.1_Marketing Agreement.pdf p. 6]
- **Marketing Agreement** — XSPA and Calm have reciprocal rights to inspect and audit agreement-related books and records. [XpresspaGroupInc_20190401_10-K_EX-10.28_11599457_EX-10.28_Marketing Agreement.pdf pp. 5, 8]
